_comment: Cues for the signature-chain take. Times are against the trimmed take,
which runs about half a second behind the script clock in its marks file.

prompter.text: Somebody I've never met liked this.
Their name is a link. Follow it into the network.
Here they are. My vouch reaches them in a few hops.
This is the key their Nerdster statements are signed with.
The statements themselves are just published on the web.
Pretty-print it. Every one is signed, and each names the one before.
Paste it into the Nerdster's verifier.
Verified. Their key, their signature, their words.

A chain of signatures, all the way back to me
vouching for somebody I know.

beats.text:
Their delegate key.
Not an account — a key.

Signature verified,
against the key we just looked at.
